globalFlags: Prices are identical on every old page, so they are treated as confirmed. compareAtPrice ('was') values come from the same source.
The old pages carried NO per-product descriptions, dimensions, weights, slot counts or belt widths. Only name, style, tagline, price, was-price, colours and photos are real per-SKU data.
The old pages' 'New In / Bestsellers / Gifting' tags and 'Bestsellers' sections were generated by array index, not real sales data; they are not carried over.

Three editorial paragraphs on the old home page were attached to the wrong products (e.g. 'shell hide' for Nova, 'zip pocket long wallet' for the Regal bifold). They are kept in brand.json under editorial.unassigned, not on products.

Older page (bundle-source) described wallet colours/leathers as Chestnut, Espresso, Walnut 'Oiled full grain', Cognac, Oxblood; these were placeholders superseded by v4 (Brown/Black/Tan, crazy horse) and are not used.
Belt lifestyle photos (products-images/*.jpg, v1) were mapped to SKUs by the old site with low confidence; see each belt's lifestyleImages note.

products.name: Nova Double-Sided Leather Belt
products.tagline: Two Sides. One Belt. Made for Every Style.
products.shortDescription: Two Sides. One Belt. Made for Every Style.

materials.leather: Crazy horse leather (full grain cowhide treated with wax)
materials.hardware: Solid brass buckle on a removable screw post
materials.thickness: 3.5mm (old page: 'Full grain hide, 3.5mm, cut in one piece')

sizes.label: Waist size
sizes.unit: inches (assumed; old page shows bare numbers 30–44)
guide: Lay a belt you already wear flat, fastened hole facing up.
Measure from the buckle bar, not the tip, to the hole you use.
Round to the nearest even number. That is your Stagr size.
Between two sizes, take the larger. Leather gives, notches do not.
